notes: This is an unresolved configuration template, not a real conference timeline or review receipt.
All file hashes must be full SHA-256 values computed from the supplied originals.

audioSplit must be explicitly session or chunk and must match the media manifest receipt. Atomic new-output publication shares prepare-media.py and requires Python 3 and Linux renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE); unsupported platforms fail without an overwrite-prone fallback.
Session document: schemaVersion/eventId/sessions; ordered IDs 00..14, actual title/t0/t1, pageRange with both deck IDs (range or null).

Mapping document: schemaVersion/eventId/sourceSha256 (plaud1 and plaud2)/rows. Each source has exactly one row: source/talk/page/reviewed/reviewer/reviewedAt. page is null or both deck IDs with 1-based page numbers or null. Speaker labels require an explicit speaker string or null per row.
No automatic slide mapping or invented session boundaries are produced. A cue crossing a program boundary remains one row assigned by its start.

The media manifest must include original audio measured durationSec from FFprobe. Subtitle ends are checked against measured original ends and the sum of measured prepared durations; planned 20400 seconds is reported separately. Overlapping/nested cues retain their full text and ends.

Review document: schemaVersion/eventId/approved/reviewer/reviewedAt/inputSha256; pins plaud1, plaud2, mediaManifest, sessions and mapping. anchorEvidence contains bookmarks=32, asrCheckpoints=38, SHA-256 and a reference to the actual R11 evidence.

Review sampling: algorithm=sha256-ranked-sources-v1, a recorded seed and sources from selectListeningSources. Exactly 10 listeningPoints contain source/subtitleTimeSec/audioTimeSec/errorSec/heardText/evidence/reviewer/reviewedAt/page/slideMatches for both decks. errorSec=subtitleTimeSec-audioTimeSec and abs(errorSec)<=0.5.
Input receipt validation cannot prove that a human listened, that browser synchronization passes, or that production is deployed.

Both decks need at least one reviewed actual page mapping before the publish-ready input gate can pass. Every generated JSON/media file must be <=25 MiB; complete-Worker asset-count/deployment verification remains separate.

Draft output reports missing approval and is not publish-ready. Unknown media/speaker/generated-slide decisions fail even draft conversion. No generated slides are supported until their separate asset contract is reviewed.
Choose a new output directory outside the media/input directories. Existing directories are never overwritten. Verified assets are copied into the atomic output bundle.
